newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer in $4 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer in $4 mln private placement.

text.p: Pioneer Commercial Funding Corp said Friday it completed its previously announced private placement.

For $4 million the company said it privately placed 2.2 million unregistered and restricted shares of common stock and $1.8 million principal amount of convertible notes, convertible at a rate of one share of common stock for each $1 of notes.

The notes will be converted into shares of common stock upon the filing of an amendment to the company's certificate of incorporation to increase the number of outstanding shares to permit full conversion of the notes.

The company said Leedan International Holdings, which subscribed for 1,375,000 shares and $1,125,000 principal amount of notes, and an affiliate, collectively hold 42.5 percent of the outstanding shares of the company, which will increase to 49 percent following note conversion.

The company also said it is in negotiations with a bank for a $25 million line of credit to be used in the funding of its mortgage warehouse operations, and expects the credit facility will close by March 31.
